steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Alas, what a charming evening – you are even more beautiful in this light. Do come in, they're playing a lovely song.

steps.name: Beautiful Noble
steps.text: Many thanks.

steps.name: Beautiful Noble
steps.text: Look at you, you came all the way out here to pick up little old me. I'm unworthy.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: I meant what I said. I'm willing to bet that a single glimpse of you would be enough to see that piano player over there forget the piece entirely.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Say, who is that lady?

steps.name: Beautiful Noble
steps.text: And what is she doing here?

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: We often say that photography is a sophisticated art, that a moment of time frozen inside a photo is instantly captivating. Whether out of a genuine obsession with art or a simple clinging to elegance, is hard to say.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: The lady over there is Pasado, a member of our Photography Society, and she's extremely fond of the latest up-and-coming photographer, Scene.

steps.name: Beautiful Noble
steps.text: Scene? Oh, that lovely young girl? I do recall enjoying some of her work the other day. Those photos really set my heart free, I could feel the love for life within them.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Precisely!

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: An adorable young photographer whose name has never appeared on a guest list before, managing to win award after award... Who wouldn't be dying to learn more about her?

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: We were just discussing the idea of shooting a documentary about her, to record her entire creation process from beginning to end. The perfect way to present her artistry!
Excuse me, would you happen to be Scene? I'm the one who sent you that correspondence.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: *Beep*—*beep*—!

steps.name: M.P.M No. 1
steps.text: *Bzzzt*

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: You are Scene, aren't you? I've written to you before. We're a group of photography enthusiasts.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: There are many in our group eager to learn from you, and since you're planning to hold a photography session in the near future, we'd like to shoot a documentary capturing your creative process.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: If it is not too much trouble for you, would you allow us to follow you and observe how a photographer with such a unique understanding of the art captures such profound images?

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: As I'm sure you well know, there are many who struggle to find meaning. And even among those who don't, they are often unable to elevate themselves to the next level. They fail to self-actualize.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Participating in a live photo session will be an invaluable experience for many newcomers, and they'll surely have much to learn from a master such as yourself.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Um, Scene, ma'am?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Ah, um...?

steps.name: Scene
steps.text: O k a y.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: *Beep*—*beep*—!

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Oh, um, excellent! I'll take that as your agreement? Thank you so much. In that case, what does your schedule look like?

steps.name: M.P.M No. 1
steps.text: *Bzzzt*

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: B-Battlefield ruins? Scene, ma'am...

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Um, yes, very well. In any case, we'll provide a list of names who will be participating. Is there anything else you need from us?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: M.P.M No. 1
steps.text: *Bzzzt*

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: 'I agree to be filmed, but please do not interfere with my creative process during the shoot.'

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Yes, yes, I understand your request, and will make sure it is conveyed clearly to all participants.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Then, I suppose I shall take my leave...?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: M.P.M No. 1
steps.text: *Bzzzt*

steps.name: Scene
steps.text: O k a y.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: I look forward to seeing you soon. Goodbye.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: (She... is nothing like what I expected... What's the matter with her? She didn't move at all...)

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: (Well, whatever. With a reputation like hers, there's no way she's a bust.)

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: Scene
steps.text: I t ' s   h e r e

steps.name: Scene
steps.text: I f   o n l y

steps.name: Scene
steps.text: I   c o u l d   h a v e

steps.name: Scene
steps.text: a c t u a l l y   b e e n   t h e r e

steps.name: Mirror
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: M.P.M No. 1
steps.text: Boop––!

steps.name: M.P.M No. 2
steps.text: *Chime* *Chime*!
A swarm of nimble little robots accompanies the taciturn photographer, lining up in formation around the ruins, each with their respective roles.
The crowd can only watch in astonishment as the robots assemble photographic equipment faster than they can react, before proceeding to survey the geography.
The passage of time has long buried blood and bone under these ruins, and stepping onto these grounds is like sinking into a long, drawn-out groan.
The machines carry the slender photographer through the dense mud and ruins.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep! Beep beep––

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Scene is beginning her work. What astounding diligence.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: This is it, children! Pay close attention, and see how Scene captures her masterpieces!

steps.name: Photographers
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Beautiful Noble
steps.text: They're already gone. What about us then?

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: We should go too.

steps.name: Beautiful Noble
steps.text: I thought this was going to last a bit longer.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: A place like this is best appreciated when you can hold it in your hand or see it hanging on a wall. When you're actually here in person, the meaning behind it is lost.

steps.name: Genial Noble
steps.text: Our ride is here. Let's get going.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Scene went over there.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Need to record some things for my commentary later.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'On the first day of the shoot, we arrived at the ruins. Perhaps Scene chose this spot because of the unique fascination young people have with the dark and edgy.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'In contrast to our expectations, she did not conduct her shoot by herself. She had machines assemble her equipment and ferry her around. We still don't know exactly why.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'Perhaps that's a part of her craft.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: You're next.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: 'Kids often like to delve into these types of settings in an attempt to show off the depth and complexity of their thought.'

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: 'She's not going to stay here more than three days.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: I don't think that's a very nice thing to say.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: And I don't think this documentary's going anywhere.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Scene is on the move again. Stay on her.

a.text: Finding the right material is a crucial part of the photographer's shoot.
What am I trying to express through my lens?
When my heart has to convey its ideas, how should I bring them out?
How should I tell my story to such bleak scenery before me? And then tell that story to others?

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'Wartorn ruins are unlike any other scenery.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'Scene must have a starting point in mind, to have chosen a place like this.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'Everyone has their own reasons for doing the things they do.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'This morning, Scene climbed to the highest part of the ruins and overlooked the entire area. It looked like her robots were noting down important locations.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'I'm not sure what she plans to do this afternoon. Maybe she'll dedicate some attention to the places she's chosen, to see if they have what she wants to express.'
By first light, Scene has already finished her preparations and set off once more.
She follows the same process as yesterday as she embarks on her solitary trek: assembling her equipment, surveying the terrain, and avoiding obstacles.
Behind her lies the stillness of the ruins, and the bustle of the crowd.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Scene got up early today. We have to hurry.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: The hot water isn't even ready yet, and you want to head out?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: She's just pretending to be busy for another day. What's the point of getting up early? We're just in for more of the going-around-in-circles like yesterday.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: After she's done milling around, we still have to put all that effort into editing the video. Then she's the one who reaps the recognition, prestige, and money –– I've seen enough of people like her.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Hear me now and believe me later. If you'd been through what I've been through, you wouldn't let a person like that use you again!

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Really...?

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Then I'll go without you.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: She just shows up, ignores everything anyone says to her, and runs around doing whatever she feels like. How's she ever going to accomplish anything?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: That's the only lesson we should be learning.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'A battlefield holds a different meaning for everyone, and I'm not sure what the rubble and ruins mean to Scene in particular. However...'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: That's not quite right for this place...

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'The photography has just started, so I can't wait to make a great documentary this time around.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'It's lunchtime. We thought Scene would take a break from work to head back to the tent, since that's where we keep all the food.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'But she seems to have brought some quick eats with her, and makes those her lunch.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'Um... I'm recording all of this to maybe give us a better understanding of her.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Why don't you head back to eat and swap with me when you're done? Scene is photographing that shell crater right now, and I don't want to miss this part.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Alright, sure. I'll go get–– Oh, he already left.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Be right back!
Day after day, Scene continues to wander through the ruins.
She does not speak to anyone, only silently ordering her robots around, kicking up a trail of fine dust over the rough ground.
She remains silent, for the battlefield is whispering to her.
Within her camera, the ruins change from real objects to shadows: the present moment turns into a flat, delicate sheet.
But behind it is the weight of reality, a freeze-frame of a moment powerful enough to overwhelm reality itself.
It is more real than the things written on a page, an affirmation of the very land's experience, a call to awaken one's consciousness.
Scene has read the records of this war: back when the battlefield was cleaned up, a crossbow bolt pulled from a corpse was heavier than the body itself.
They clearly knew they would die, yet they still fought on.
Their blood dyed the ground black, so thick that not a single plant could grow here.
The distant morning light penetrates the thin clouds and sprinkles across the ground. This place of death finally glows with a bit of the sun's golden light.
Atop a high, withered branch, Scene presses the shutter to record this moment of false life.
A hoarse fowlbeast rises from the dead branch, its thin claws loosening up a small puff of dust. Time flies away from this single fragment of a moment.
Behind the fine dust hide the restless eyes of others.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: I haven't slept soundly these past few days. Been waking up with a headache every morning.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: What's she doing up so early? The material isn't going anywhere, and she's not even saying anything.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: And she's staying so close to that place too. Sure knows how to pick a good location.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Newbie photographers just don't know how to get things done.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'Ninth day of the shoot.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'I don't know if every battlefield turns out to be like this.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'I wondered if anyone came here to paying respects to fallen family members, but in the few times I've followed Scene around, I haven’t seen flowers or anything of the sort.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'Maybe too much time has passed, or the cities have gone too far from these ruins for anyone to ever come back again.'

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: See that? She's just a pretentious foreigner.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: She's a foreigner? Never would've guessed.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Yeah, from Bolívar. I bet she's participating in our Photography Society on behalf of the nobles. Probably came here after hearing they wanted to do a shot of a battlefield to curry their favor or something.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Let's drop it. You really shouldn't talk behind someone's back.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: What's the big deal? Someone like that already knows she's being badmouthed. It'd be weirder if you didn't give her some shit.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: 'My pants are already dirty. That one's putting on a good show sitting in a car like that, not getting her feet dirty at all. Wasted a bunch of time just looking around idly.'

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: 'If photography's such a good profession, how much money can I make from this documentary?'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: We really need to cut that part out...

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Hah, I'll be the one making that call. I'm the one editing the video, not you.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Scene, would you like to come back to camp for dinner tonight? We boiled some hot water in the morning. We can cook you a hot meal.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: I'm the one who boiled the water! Why are you sharing with her?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: She has her robots to do everything for her. We need to take care of ourselves first!

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Come now, show a little hospitality.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: I'll go boil some more water. We're not going to run out.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: You're gonna boil the water? You don't think you've been running enough errands?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: What's the point of doing that? Is she gonna tip you? Thank you? Will you get a raise?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: She's gonna get both fame and fortune once we finish the shoot. And what will you get? Bah, boil water.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Enough of that, this is our job. I...

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: I'll do it.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Well shit, aren't you the good little worker drone?

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Let's not start a fight...

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: I'm TEACHING you!

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Look here, who here's actually treating you better? Is it the one who doesn't say a word or the other who just does her own thing? How long do you plan to stupidly bumble along as her entourage?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Work when you get work. Take a few pictures of what you're asked to shoot. And if the pictures can express a tiny sliver of what you hoped to convey, are you gonna go happily on your way thinking it's your own work?

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Wake up already!

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: W-Well, we can always find something we want to shoot...

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: You could shoot something that inspires you, just like Scene––

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: ––Shut up, dumbass!

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Say that again! Try me!

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Why are you–

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: Hah! I don't give a shit anymore.

steps.name: Restless Photographer
steps.text: You don't deserve to learn from me, and this film isn't worth my time.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep, beep beep.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'Ster left today.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'He got pretty opinionated about the shoot... Or, I guess, about a lot of other things.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'I can't leave yet. I need to finish this job. Maybe he was right, maybe I will be happy if this project manages to express even a little sliver of what I hoped to convey.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'I can't make my own work, the way people like Scene can. But, still...'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Wait, I can't be recording stuff like that. Better delete it...

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'Judging from these last few days of filming, it appears Scene loves capturing a precisely thrilling moment.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'Naturally, war ruins have plenty of places worth digging around, and the conditions here are much more difficult than I expected. This is the first time I've been in a place like this.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: 'But I'm starting to worry, now that we're short a crew member.'

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Hm, you're back? Want to record something?

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Ster left?

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: He never wanted to be here. Not from the very beginning.

steps.name: Placid Photographer
steps.text: I've been thinking... can we even continue filming like this?

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'I've taken my own pictures of the battlefield. It's different from what I experienced myself... and that's exactly what I wanted. I am trying to understand the anatomy of a war.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'After a few days of filming Scene, I've come to realize that she is working tirelessly to tell the story of these ruins.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'When this is over, I might like to have a chat with her.'
Lens moves from the ruins to the camp, bringing back a note.
As the crew members leave one after another, the discussions among the them spill over into outward panic.
They argue, refuse to work, and leave one by one.
Scene continues shooting amid the turbulence, slowly raising her camera and pressing the shutter.
*click*
The ruins she experiences and records are not just those of war.

steps.name: Mirror
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: M.P.M No. 1
steps.text: *Bzzzt*

steps.name: M.P.M No. 2
steps.text: *Chime* *Chime*!

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'Scene is getting ready to apply the finishing touches. After more than two weeks, our filming is about to come to an end.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'The last members of the film crew left about three days ago. They said there's no way we'd be able to finish the filming.'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'I've shot enough material to make a documentary of my own, so––'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Um... Scene, ma'am?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: Beep beep!

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Is this for me? Did you want to talk?

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: 'The others all left. Why did you stay?'

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Well, let's sit down and chat.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: When you look at this battlefield, what do you think about? The clash of civilization against barbarism? The surging tide of history? Or is it... at the most fundamental level, the loss of human life?

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: I came to shoot the battlefield, because war took everything from me.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: Not on this battlefield specifically, but that doesn't matter.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: I left home and came here to be a photographer, to take pictures of all sorts of people and places. Though they are sometimes happy and sometimes not, at least they are still alive.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: I'm also alive, but I've never been able to experience the things that would make me feel truly alive.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: So I wanted to come face-to-face with a battlefield.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: I don't have the courage to go back to that particular one. I can't, anymore. Coming here is all I can do.

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: I ask myself, when people look back at these ruins through a lens, years down the road, what will they think?

steps.name: Pasado
steps.text: And years down the road, will I have the courage to go back?
Scene remains silent. Her silence persists so long that Pasado can't help but assume she won't ever answer any of her questions.
She draws a deep breath and decides to leave.
Behind her comes the sound of a shutter clicking, ever so softly. She turns back around, and sees Scene put down her camera, her lips slowly curling into a smile.
This is the first time she's ever seen the photographer's expression change.
She hears her words – slow, but resolute:
'W e  h a v e  t o...  r e c o r d  i t  a l l.'
'T h e  r u i n s...  t h e  t r a c e s  o f  p e o p l e.'
'T o  s h o w  t h e m  a g a i n.'
